source_of_truth.binary_asset_policy: Formal .blend files are stored externally; this manifest and the repository scripts define the reviewable interchange contract.
source_of_truth.coordinate_system: Blender right-handed Z-up, metres; exported to Unreal Z-up centimetres by the FBX importer
source_of_truth.shared_origin: All modules use the surveyed project origin at Blender world (0, 0, 0).

modules.pivot_rule: Pivot remains at the shared surveyed project origin; apply mesh transforms before export and do not centre on bounds.

collision.strategy: Simple UCX hulls; use UCX_SM_Architecture_Podium_## naming.

modules.lod_or_distant_proxy: Provide HLOD-ready simplified podium shell; author LOD1/LOD2 if Nanite is rejected.

modules.pivot_rule: Pivot remains at the shared surveyed project origin so tower and podium align; never use per-object bounding-box pivots.

collision.strategy: Simple UCX volumes for accessible faces only; use UCX_SM_Architecture_Towers_## naming.

modules.lod_or_distant_proxy: Provide one merged skyline proxy for HLOD and non-Nanite fallback LOD1/LOD2.

modules.pivot_rule: Use the shared project origin, retaining surveyed elevations; apply transforms before export.

collision.strategy: No collision by default; add explicitly only for reachable maintenance areas.

modules.lod_or_distant_proxy: Merge small plant into a simplified rooftop silhouette for distant HLOD; cull sub-pixel equipment.

modules.description_zh_hant: 住宅入口及大堂可見部分
modules.pivot_rule: Use the shared project origin to preserve facade alignment; entrance submeshes may have local origins but must export in world position.

collision.strategy: Simple doorway, floor and wall UCX shapes; keep openings traversable.

modules.lod_or_distant_proxy: Entrances may disappear into the podium HLOD beyond the near-field range; provide LOD1 if separate.

modules.pivot_rule: Use the shared project origin; retain storefront and sign positions relative to the podium facade.

collision.strategy: Simple storefront collision only; exclude thin signs and glazing from collision.

modules.lod_or_distant_proxy: Bake signage and storefront variation into the podium distant proxy; author LOD1 for close street views.
